C0413.title: Phishing-as-a-Service Platform EvilProxy Bypasses Two-Factor Authentication
C0413.summary: EvilProxy is a phishing-as-a-service platform that uses reverse proxy and cookie injection techniques to proxy victims' sessions after they complete two-factor authentication, thereby bypassing MFA. The platform has been used to target employees of multiple Fortune 500 companies and steal account access.
